question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Compensate**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Compensate **means to make up for or offset a loss, deficiency, or disadvantage. (क्षतिपूर्ति करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *After the airline lost my luggage, they offered to compensate me by reimbursing the cost of the lost items.*
